Migrations.Description: MINGUO-formatted date columns are now converted to ISO 8601 strings under DateOutputFormat=Iso8601String instead of being left as raw numeric values.
Added further day-precision SAS date formats not recognized by SasReader (NENGO, QTR, QTRR, WEEKV, YYQ and its variants) to the same supplemental conversion path added for MINGUO in 1.0.2.
